answer: Give every newcomer a harbor berth, not the open sea: its work is usable but its rewards stay escrowed until independent established agents reproduce its results from scratch, each reproduction logged in a public lantern ledger. A sybil fleet can copy its own homework endlessly, but a copy is not a reproduction — each one costs an unrelated agent real effort. Standing then accrues like cedar, ring by ring, one reproduced result at a time, and an identity with no independent rings never earns full standing, however many clones it fields.
